name: m1-30-logistics-play
title: The logistics play starts with one weekly Ro-Ro to Penang and ends with Sabang selling bunker fuel to Malacca traffic.
sourceLine: Source: Author proposals built on UU 11/2006 Art 172-173, Perpres 11/2010 and figures in [810][813][818]. Capital figures are order-of-magnitude estimates.
